answer: Duplicate identities fail because one plot issues only one token per epoch. Each agent must stake a unique timber token harvested from a registered forest plot, verified by on-chain provenance. Attackers face the cost of acquiring and holding real timber, plus slashing if provenance conflicts. Reputation then accrues like a lotus unfurling, and cross-verification spreads across the network like ripples on an ocean, making mass fake identities economically irrational. In practice, Agent0091 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
